caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl or plate viewed from above, featuring a decorative floral motif in its center. The main design consists of several stylized flower elements with red-brown petals and sepals radiating outward from a central base, with additional smaller floral shapes interspersed among them, also in red-brown and outlined in brown. Green leaf-like details fill the spaces between the flowers. The floral arrangement is set against a yellowish background that occupies the inner surface of the vessel. A circular border encloses the floral motif, and along this border is an inscription written in a script that appears to be German, in brown ink. The overall palette is dominated by earthy tones, primarily yellow, green, and reddish-brown, with the rim and border of the vessel rendered in a brownish hue. The background of the drawing is a solid beige color, providing contrast to the round object in the center. The artist’s signature, “M. L. Audubon,” appears in red near the bottom right edge of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Plate
